about_the_game:
Chronicles of Battle


Step into the boots of a true medieval ruler and experience the chaos and strategy of battle like never before. This DLC brings your campaigns to life by adding detailed visualizations to your battle reports, allowing you to see the rise and fall of combat as it unfolds. Whether you’re leading a bold charge or defending your capital, every decision is now illustrated in vivid detail.

Battle Visualizations


Completely optional but highly immersive, this DLC introduces visualized battle reports through a series of images that depict the entire course of a battle. These visualizations will include:

  • A simple battlefield overview, showing whether the fight took place in open terrain or before the walls of the capital.
  • Regiments and their positions relative to each other during different stages of the battle.
  • A system of arrows illustrating the sequence of individual attacks.
  • Tooltips providing detailed updates on changes in the number of warriors in each regiment after every attack.

This DLC is dedicated to the loyal fans of King’s Orders who wish to support the continued development of the game. Your contribution helps us create more exciting content for all rulers to enjoy!
